resources.string: How do I use Pocket Pixel
Why is your app not working
Copy all your .gb ROM files into a directory on your device and select it. This gives Pocket Pixel access to all files in this directory. After the scan is complete, you should see your games
If your games are compressed, try unzipping them. Go to settings and try rescanning your directory. Else report problem on github issues. Also post a fix please.

Emulation of game boy is totally legal. What is not legal is piracy of ROMs. Thus, you the user, have to acquire ROMs yourself and the server has been shutdown. I love piracy but Nintendo does not. As for adds and privacy. There will never be adds on this app and you can check the source code for yourself here:
Pocket Pixel needs to scan a directory containing Game Boy ROMs. This might take a few seconds.

1. Copy your .gb or .gbc files into a folder on your device. 2. Ensure they are NOT in a zip file. 3. Go to Settings in this app. 4. Tap Select Directory and choose your ROMs folder. 5. Wait for the scan to finish and your games will appear on the Home screen.
Yes! Pocket Pixel is completely open source. You can view, audit, or contribute to the source code on GitHub using the link below.
Never. Pocket Pixel is and will always be 100% ad-free. No interruptions, no tracking, just pure retro gaming.
Your privacy is paramount. No data ever leaves your device. Everything—including your game saves, screenshots, and settings—is stored locally on your phone.
This app uses RetroAchievements, you need to create an account on the Retro Achievements website, login here and then play.
Hardcore achievements require that save states be disabled. Go to settings, you will find hardcore toggle under miscellaneous.
No, your achievements are stored on Retro Achievements, so deleting Pocket Pixel or factory reset wont delete your achievements.
Go to settings -> Audio and turn the sliders down (especially Noise) and use your devices audio buttons to increase volume.
1. Connect your controller via Bluetooth or USB. 2. Go to Settings. 3. Tap on any detected button or axis under Current Bindings. 4. Press the physical button on your controller to map it.
No. You are responsible for acquiring your games fairly. We recommend scanning physical cartridges you own or playing homebrew games from sites like itch.io.
While playing, open the In-game Settings and select Screenshot under the Misc tab. You can view them by tapping View Screenshots in the main Settings menu.
Deferred saving is a performance feature. Instead of pausing the game to save data immediately, it waits until you exit the emulator. This prevents minor stutters during gameplay.

Open the In-game Settings while playing. Under the States tab, you can select one of 5 slots to Save or Load your exact progress at any moment. If you cant see the States tab, stop the game, go to Settings, under Miscellaneous, toggle off Hardcore Mode
Yes! Go to Settings and look for the Visual section. You can choose from classic Game Boy palettes or apply shaders like CRT or Chromatic Aberration for a more authentic feel.
Long-press any game card on the Home screen to open the action menu. From there, you can select Delete Save File to clear the battery RAM (SRAM) for that game.
Turn off Immersive Mode in settings.
